models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Light, benign pattern over the Aeolians right now - but 5 days out, treat none of it as a trip forecast.
briefing.synopsis: The current picture is slack: winds across all six island points are running 1-7 kt, mostly from the N through NE, with a daily land/sea-breeze wobble rather than any gradient - Portorosa swings from S/SSE overnight to NNE/NE by midday. Seas are collapsing, from around 1.0 ft total wave and swell at Filicudi and Stromboli early on 28 Sep to 0.1 ft by 29-30 Sep in the consensus across all models with data. There is no organised system in view through the model horizon of 04 Oct 23:00. Note that at 28 Sep 00Z-12Z off Portorosa the models disagreed by more than 6 kt (range 1.2-9.6 kt), so the light-air mean there is not a certainty.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: Nothing to decide tonight - the fleet is not aboard yet. For reference, the scored berth for the night of 03 Oct is Portorosa Marina, enclosed with all-round shelter, showing 3.3 kt ESE, gusts 8.7 kt and 0.1 ft swell on the current run. At those numbers the choice of berth does not matter; only a genuine gradient wind appearing in later runs would change that.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: No departure window applies tomorrow - arrival and briefing are still 5 days out. The nearest thing to a real number for the trip is the 04 Oct Portorosa to Lipari window, which currently scores 'go' from 06:00 with 4.4 kt S, gusts 10.3 kt and 0.1 ft seas, a run at TWA 161. Expect that to be re-briefed from scratch once the trip dates are inside 48-72 h; the direction, not the strength, is the part most likely to move.

passage_notes.note: Only trip leg inside the horizon. 'Go' verdict, recommended 06:00 departure, 4.4 kt S and 0.1 ft seas, all windows 06:00-14:00 scoring go. Wind backs S-SW-WNW-NW through the day, so later starts become motoring head to wind. Sails at the very edge of the run - low weight.

cautions: Everything from 05 Oct onward is outside the model horizon (04 Oct 23:00). Any leg or berth score you see for those dates comes from the rehearsal dry run against this week's live weather and is not a forecast for the trip.

The gust figures in light air are interval maxima - ECMWF IFS 0.25° (27 Sep 18Z) publishes a maximum over the output interval, so 10-16 kt gusts against 2-5 kt means (e.g. 16.1 kt at Filicudi, 18:00 on 30 Sep) are an artefact of that method rather than a squall signal.

Stromboli's only scored berth, Marina del Gabbiano, is rated 'workable' not sheltered - open from every direction, so it only works if it stays calm. Keep a fallback in mind if later runs show any gradient wind for that night.

Direction is the weak link: forecast-stability tracking shows mean wind-speed shifts of only 0.9 kt at 72-120 h lead, but mean direction shifts of 69° - fine for a 4 kt day, decisive for anchorage choice.
briefing.confidence_note: Confidence is moderate for the pattern itself - light and consistent across ECMWF IFS 0.25° (27 Sep 18Z), ECMWF AIFS (28 Sep 00Z) and ICON-2i (28 Sep 00Z), with MFWAM (27 Sep 12Z) and ECMWF WAM agreeing on near-flat seas - but low for the trip dates, which lie at or beyond the 04 Oct 23:00 horizon where direction shifts average 69°.
